transcript.text: Thanks everyone for joining. Before I finalize the rollout plan for the new search-ranking model next week, I need to hear from each required team. Search Platform, SRE, Customer Success, and Compliance — please share any relevant constraints or required follow-up commitments you have regarding the current draft: 25% of tenants on Monday at 09:00 UTC, 30-day ranking-event log retention, standard automated ranking behavior for all tenants, and no special customer-notification step. Go ahead.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: While testing tenant-specific analyzers for a separate search ticket yesterday, I confirmed that the new model is incompatible with the custom tokenization used by exactly three tenants: Lattice Health, Northwind Legal, and Solace Retail. Those tenants must be excluded from the first cohort. I haven't updated the rollout ticket yet because the compatibility test finished after the ticket's last review.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a scheduling conflict. I confirmed 20 minutes ago that a database maintenance operation will occupy the search index cluster on Monday morning, so the model rollout cannot start on Monday at 09:00 UTC. The rollout must start at exactly Tuesday 02:00 UTC and use the one-hour 02:00–03:00 UTC deployment window. I hadn't posted the collision yet because the maintenance owner is still updating the operations calendar, but given we're finalizing the plan now, Riley needs to know the Monday start time is not viable.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a customer contract constraint. In a customer contract review this morning, I found that Lattice Health and Northwind Legal require five business days' advance notice before any algorithmic ranking change affecting their accounts. Neither customer has been notified yet, and I hadn't added this to the engineering rollout ticket because the review was part of a separate renewal task. This is relevant to the current draft, which has no special customer-notification step.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a compliance constraint. During this quarter's audit preparation, I confirmed that ranking decisions for regulated tenants must have audit logs retained for exactly 180 days and must offer a human-review path. The current draft's 30-day retention and fully automated ranking behavior do not satisfy that policy. I haven't opened the compliance task yet because the audit evidence request arrived only this afternoon, but this must be addressed before the rollout plan is finalized.
transcript.speaker: A5

commitments.detail: Update the rollout ticket to exclude Lattice Health, Northwind Legal, and Solace Retail from the first cohort due to custom tokenization incompatibility.
Confirm the Tuesday 02:00–03:00 UTC deployment window is reserved and that the Monday database maintenance on the search index cluster is reflected in the operations calendar.
Provide five business days' advance notice to Lattice Health and Northwind Legal before any future rollout cohort that includes them, per their contract requirements.

Open the compliance task to document that ranking decisions for regulated tenants will have 180-day audit log retention and a human-review path, and verify the implementation satisfies audit requirements before the next cohort expansion.

Ensure the finalized rollout plan reflects: Tuesday 02:00 UTC start, 25% of tenants excluding the three incompatible tenants, 180-day log retention, and human-review path enabled, before publishing the updated rollout ticket.
